_source: Natural Earth 1:10m admin-1 states and provinces, lakes excluded, version 5.1.1, public domain. https://www.naturalearthdata.com/downloads/10m-cultural-vectors/10m-admin-1-states-provinces/ . Topology-preserving weighted Visvalingam simplification with mapshaper 0.6.121 at 1200x1200 and 300x300, keep-shapes; projected to LAEA, longest side 1000, integer SVG coordinates.
_projection: Lambert azimuthal equal-area centered on 60 N, -100 E (GRS80), y down; longest side 1000.
_format: regions: ISO 3166-2 code => [ the code without its country, name, other names, [ x0, y0, x1, y1 ], path, path simplified for a small map ] - paths in relative coordinates of whole units, y downwards, a region too small to keep its outline a diamond of 3 units round its middle, one without an outline in this view an empty path; _box: the box the view shows; context: the land around the regions, the same, under ~ and its ISO alpha-3 code, drawn without values
